articles.title: Six CSS Snippets Every Developer Should Know in 2025
articles.description: Adam shared a similar list last year and it proved incredibly popular — as such, he’s back again with another grab bag of hefty snippets which are “bigger, more powerful, and leverage progressive enhancement a bit more”.
articles.author: Adam Argyle

articles.title: ❤️ Top Pens of 2024 on CodePen
articles.description: Plenty of superb inspiration, demos, and neat tricks on show here. Whether that’s a neat parallax effect, a retro VHS look achieved with CSS, a rad web component that adds particles to your pointer, or this 3D image carousel. Lots of cool stuff to dig into.
articles.author: CodePen

articles.title: Cool People Link to Text Fragments
articles.description: Did you know that support for linking to text fragments is now enabled across all major browsers? It means you don’t need elements to have an ID in order to navigate to it, instead you can go directly to a specific text string. Chris briefly shows us how.
articles.author: Chris Coyier

articles.title: The UX of Login Codes
articles.description: Brad explores the often very real friction that’s found between offering a great user experience and great security, along with the challenges and compromises that come with delivering both. “If your product texts/emails login codes, the experience better be amazing.”
articles.author: Brad Frost

articles.title: ▶  What is the Shared Storage API?
articles.description: Tara Agyemang from the Chrome team talks us through why we need shared storage, its privacy benefits, common use cases, and how we can use it.
articles.author: Chrome for Developers

articles.title: 'My Website Has Been Gaslighting You'
articles.description: Quite the provocative headline! Dave has been changing his site ever so slightly every day, tweaking the CSS by setting a --hue variable and rotating the hue about 1deg each day to make it 360º around a color wheel over the year. A fun little experiment.
articles.author: Dave Rupert

articles.title: Avoid Multiple Page Redirects: How Redirects Impact Page Speed
articles.description: Redirects add in steps that can delay page load, in-turn affecting user experience and Core Web Vitals results. As such, this post looks at how to optimize redirects to ensure faster browsing for visitors.
articles.author: Conor McCarthy

articles.title: Don’t Wrap Figure in a Link
articles.description: Highlights the inconsistent and problematic behaviours such as practice can inflict on voice control users.
articles.author: Adrian Roselli

articles.title: Shapecatcher: Draw the Unicode Character You Want
articles.description: Looking for a specific Unicode character, or just something close enough to represent what you want? This is pretty neat. Draw a shape in the box and you get the closest matches, ready to copy and paste.
articles.author: Benjamin Milde

articles.title: TailwindCSS Snippets: A Small Collection of Unique Tailwind Animations
articles.description: You can right-click each of the animations to copy the code or send the code to the official Tailwind playground, where you can live edit and customize as needed.
articles.author: Alexandru Ţurcanu

articles.title: Drupal CMS 1.0 Released
articles.description: The Drupal project is now 24 years old(!), and we now have two options for building with it — the original Core experience, or this new ready-to-use platform.
articles.author: Dries Buytaert

articles.title: Data Viz Project: A Huge Collection of Data Visualizations
articles.description: Mostly for inspiration or when you’re not sure what type of chart or graph to use. Currently includes more than 160 types of visualizations under 5 main ‘families’.
articles.author: Ferdio
